## Gauge Freedom, Inc.

[Gauge Freedom](https://www.gaugefreedom.com/) is a research-driven technology company I co-founded in 2025 to connect fundamental science with practical computational innovation. A California benefit corporation, its interests include energy-efficient artificial intelligence, quantum computing, verifiable AI systems, and open scientific software, drawing on mathematical physics and information theory.

We welcome collaborations and consulting opportunities in scientific modeling and advanced computational methods, particularly energy-efficient AI and quantum computing.

[Visit Gauge Freedom →](https://www.gaugefreedom.com/) · [Consulting & Collaboration](../consulting-services/index.qmd) · [Contact](../contact/index.qmd)

I also serve as Co-Editor-in-Chief of [Gauge Freedom Journal](https://www.gaugefreedom.org/), supporting open and reproducible scientific publishing.
